acceptance_criteria.text: Feature registry lists every Omarchy quattro shell plugin, bar widget/indicator, panel, theme pack, theme/bg CLI family, and Style-menu action with status port|adapt|rebuild|done|defer|triage and gnomarchi_path.
Overlay installs and enables user-themes plus appindicator and first-party gnomarchi extensions; gnome-tweaks remains available; enablement survives GDM restart on the test VM.

A visual theme picker (menu Style > Theme and Super+Ctrl+T equivalent) lists all packs with preview, applies via gnomarchi theme set, and refreshes GTK/Ghostty/nvim/btop/Chromium/Shell CSS/wallpaper like Omarchy theme-set.
Background picker (Style > Background / Super+Ctrl+W equivalent) cycles stills for the active theme using generated or licensed assets only (no Omarchy binary walls).
Panel chips for agents, weather, system-update, and tailscale remain visible; Agents window and unified menu Style tree expose theme/background actions.
VM validation checklist covers every visually checkable shipped feature; each item has a screenshot under docs/screenshots/parity-v2/ with pass/fail recorded.

user_stories: As a gnomarchi user on stock GNOME, I open Style > Theme and pick a pack the way Omarchy does, and the whole desktop restyles.
As an installer, overlay gives me user-themes and tray extensions without hand-enabling.
As a maintainer, the registry tells me exactly what Omarchy surface is still missing and how we adapt it under D1′.
As QA, I run the VM checklist and attach screenshots for every visual feature.
non_goals: No vendoring Omarchy binary backgrounds, unlocks, or app marks without CREDITS
No full OWE video-wallpaper engine in this wave
No Omarchy ISO/gaming/Windows-VM (P8/P9) in this wave
No claim of official Omarchy affiliation
risks: Shell CSS via user-themes breaks after GNOME minor bumps
Extension enable races on GDM restart
D7 branding if previews look too Omarchy-official
test_implications: Unit: theme list/set, extension metadata shell-version includes host
Integration: overlay dry-run lists user-themes + appindicator
VM visual: checklist AC-6 with screenshots for theme carousel, wallpaper, panel chips, menu Style, Agents, Ghostty palette
